summary: Staff can author Markdown or HTML blocks in the Editor.js composer; the server sanitizes markup before public articles render it.
detailed_changes: Added a Markdown/HTML markup block in the staff post editor.
Server converts Markdown and strips unsafe HTML (scripts, handlers, disallowed tags) before save.
Public article renderer outputs the sanitized stored HTML for markup blocks.
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff editors; public readers of articles with markup blocks
Public impact: new Markdown/HTML content can appear on published articles after review/publish
Internal impact: editors gain a dedicated markup block; no Stripe or upload changes
